source: console, 2026-11-12, stale PR triage (operator decision: close and file items). PR #1263 closed unmerged; branch claude/cloud-build-evolve-loop-3qqufa kept as reference
summary: PR #1263 (claude/cloud-build-evolve-loop-3qqufa) was built in the cloud window on 2026-11-03/04 and fell 400+ commits behind main. It was closed unmerged. Its description: ## Summary - **Why main has no `Reviewed-by` trailer since 2026-10-09.** Of the 1038 non-merge commits on main since that date, 645 are console commits. Each has neither the ship diff footer (`## Actual diff`) nor a review trailer. Ship always writes that footer, so a bare `git commit` on a PR branch made these commits and `evolve ship` never ran. The attestations stayed in `dev/*/.commit-gate`. The other 393 commits are cycle commits (164) and dossier commits (229). - **What is wrong in the code.** Only `evolve ship --class manual` writes review trailers (`reviewTrailer`). Even through ship, the trailer named only the profiles. It did not carry the `run:` ids or the class. - **The fix.** -
title: Rebuild on current main: a manual ship commit carries its review class and its review run ids (review-routing S0)
